policy.notes: Direct deps are protocol (serde/clap), hashing (sha2/hex), atomic temp publish (tempfile), errors (thiserror), and minimal Arrow/Parquet readers (default-features=false; snap enabled for common Snappy Parquet).

directDependencies.justification: Task/receipt/capabilities JSON protocol — derive Serialize/Deserialize only.
Machine handshake and task documents are JSON file I/O.
Typed fail-closed error codes for protocol/path/limit violations.
Deterministic content hashing for native receipts (dataset.hash / parquet_hash).
Scratch/temp paths for atomic publish; not a business authority store.
CLI for --capabilities/--task only; no shell interpolation.
Encode digests for receipt contentHash fields.

transitiveHighlights.justification: Snappy decompression for common Parquet corpora; no extra codec stack enabled.
Arrow crate graph pulled by parquet arrow feature — kept minimal via default-features=false.

explicitlyAvoided: tokio / async runtime — sync CLI only
reqwest / networking — no outbound I/O from native binary
full arrow / parquet default features — compression/IPC stack trimmed
sqlite / sled — no competing domain DB inside native binary
